Employee Salary Auto-Initializer

Problem Statement:

Write a program that uses a default constructor to automatically initialize employee salary details and compute the final salary after tax deduction.

Description:
Create a class Employee that:
1. Uses a default constructor (no parameters).
2. Inside the constructor, read:
Basic Salary
HRA percentage
DA percentage
Tax percentage
3. Compute:
Gross Salary = Basic + (HRA% of Basic) + (DA% of Basic)
Net Salary = Gross - (Tax% of Gross)
4. Display the final Net Salary rounded to 2 decimal places.

Input Format:

Four space-separated numbers:

BasicSalary HRA% DA% Tax%

Output Format:

Single value representing Net Salary (rounded to 2 decimal places).
